customer_id.meaning: primary id of the resident profile (seed uuid or content hash); one profile per natural person who signs a Larkspur lease, add-on agreement or application

name.meaning: full legal name of the resident exactly as printed on the lease and the government ID presented at application

phone_number.meaning: mobile number registered on the resident portal profile; used for rent reminders and as an identity credential

email.meaning: email address registered on the resident portal profile, stored in lower case; used for statements and as an identity credential

date_of_birth.meaning: resident's date of birth as captured from the government ID at application; an identity credential

ssn_last4.meaning: last four digits of the Social Security or ITIN number submitted for screening; an identity credential

profile_opened_date.meaning: calendar date the resident profile was first created (the date of the resident's first Larkspur application)

verification_id.meaning: primary id of the verification record, a content hash of the customer id (one record per resident, upserted)

customer_id.meaning: resident whose identity was checked (foreign key -> customers)

verified.meaning: whether the caller passed identity verification; once true it is never set back to false

verified_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
verified_at.meaning: moment of the most recent verification attempt

handoff_id.meaning: primary id of the handoff record, a content hash of customer id and reason

customer_id.meaning: resident handed over to a human resident services specialist (foreign key -> customers)

reason.meaning: why the conversation was handed to a human; closed set of exactly these two values

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

lease_id.meaning: primary id of the apartment home lease record

variant_name.meaning: floor plan leased, written as the official floor plan tier name

status.meaning: lease lifecycle state (basis defined in products/lease.yaml lifecycle.states)

community_name.meaning: Larkspur community where the leased apartment home is located

community_state.meaning: two-letter US state of the community; the jurisdiction whose landlord-tenant statutes govern the lease

unit_number.meaning: apartment home designation exactly as printed on the lease, building-unit form such as 3-214

application_date.meaning: date the rental application was submitted; the opening date of the lease record

move_in_date.meaning: date keys were issued and possession began; empty until move-in

move_out_date.meaning: date possession ended (keys returned, abandonment confirmed or writ executed); empty while in possession

monthly_rent.meaning: current monthly base rent in force for the apartment home, before any add-on, utility or fee; changes only through a recorded rent change

balance_due.meaning: current outstanding balance on the lease ledger (rent, lease fees, late fees, returned payment fees, court costs) net of payments and credits; identically the sum of rent_receivable deltas; positive means the resident owes

occupants_count.meaning: total persons (adults and minors) approved to occupy the apartment home

adult_applicants_count.meaning: number of adult applicants (18 or older) screened on the application

gross_monthly_income.meaning: combined verified gross monthly income of all adult applicants at screening

screening_credit_score.meaning: highest credit score among adult applicants returned by the screening bureau at application

screening_result.meaning: outcome of resident screening recorded by the screening service

rent_discount_program.meaning: ongoing rent discount program the lease is enrolled in, fixed at lease signing; at most one

autopay_enrolled.meaning: whether recurring ACH autopay is enrolled on the resident portal for this lease

insurance_on_file.meaning: whether proof of renter's liability insurance meeting the floor plan minimum is currently on file

certified_funds_only.meaning: whether the lease is currently restricted to certified funds for payments after returned payments

certified_funds_until.meaning: last calendar date of the certified-funds restriction; empty when no restriction has ever been imposed

closed_date.meaning: date the lease record was closed after the final account statement; empty while open

charge_id.meaning: primary id of the lease ledger charge or credit line

lease_id.meaning: lease the line posts to (foreign key -> leases)

event_type.meaning: event family of the line, verbatim from products/lease.yaml

charge_code.meaning: ledger charge code of the line; rent, fee, late fee, returned payment fee or credit code

billing_period.meaning: calendar month the line belongs to (the rent month it bills or credits)

charge_date.meaning: date the line was posted to the ledger; for rent lines the rent due date

amount.meaning: amount of the line, always positive; charges increase the balance due and credits decrease it (direction given by the event family)

proration_days.meaning: days billed for a prorated line; equals days_in_period for a full-month line and 0 for lines that are not day-based

days_in_period.meaning: actual calendar days in the billing period used as the proration denominator; 0 for lines that are not day-based

service_window.meaning: for lockout service lines, whether the lockout was answered in business hours (8:00-18:00 local, Monday-Saturday) or after hours; not_applicable otherwise

source_charge_id.meaning: for a credit line, the charge_id of the single charge it reverses, waives or discounts; empty for charges and for concessions not tied to one charge

source_payment_id.meaning: for a returned payment fee, the payment_id of the dishonored payment; empty otherwise

payment_id.meaning: primary id of the payment or payment return record

lease_id.meaning: lease the payment was received on (foreign key -> leases)

payment_method.meaning: instrument the payment was made with (deposit_application when the security deposit is applied to the lease balance at final accounting); for a return, the instrument of the returned payment

amount.meaning: amount received, or for a return the amount of the dishonored payment reversed; always positive

payment_date.meaning: date the payment was received, or for a return the date the bank or card network returned it

payment_reference.meaning: confirmation number issued by the payment portal, the money order / cashier's check serial number, or for a deposit_application the deposit transaction id, exactly as issued

source_payment_id.meaning: for a return, the payment_id of the original payment being reversed; empty for payments

return_reason.meaning: reason code of a returned payment; not_applicable for payments

plan_request_id.meaning: payment plan this payment is a down payment or installment of (foreign key -> lease_payment_plan_requests); empty for ordinary payments

notice_id.meaning: primary id of the notice or referral record

lease_id.meaning: lease the notice concerns (foreign key -> leases)

notice_date.meaning: date the notice was served, or for a referral the date the file was referred to eviction counsel

cure_deadline.meaning: last calendar date on which the resident may cure (pay in full or correct the violation); empty for referrals

amount_demanded.meaning: past-due rent demanded in a delinquency notice, or the balance referred; 0.00 for violation notices

billing_period.meaning: latest rent month whose unpaid rent is demanded or referred; empty for violation notices

service_method.meaning: how the notice was served; not_applicable for referrals

violation_code.meaning: lease covenant breached for a violation notice; not_applicable for delinquency notices and referrals

plan_request_id.meaning: primary id of the payment plan agreement request

customer_id.meaning: leaseholder requesting the plan (foreign key -> customers)

lease_id.meaning: lease whose arrears the plan covers (foreign key -> leases)

arrears_amount.meaning: past-due balance the plan covers, as of the date the plan was drawn up

down_payment_amount.meaning: amount the resident pays on signing, before the first installment

installment_count.meaning: number of equal installments after the down payment

installment_amount.meaning: amount of each installment (arrears minus down payment, divided by installment count, rounded to the cent; the last installment absorbs any rounding difference)

first_installment_date.meaning: due date of the first installment

request_status.meaning: status of the plan: submitted (drawn up, awaiting the resident's signature), signed, declined_by_resident, completed (all installments paid), defaulted

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
created_at.meaning: moment the plan request was drawn up

term_id.meaning: primary id of the Lease Term Agreement

customer_id.meaning: leaseholder who signed the term (foreign key -> customers)

lease_id.meaning: apartment home lease the term belongs to (foreign key -> leases)

variant_name.meaning: term program of the agreement, official term tier name

status.meaning: term lifecycle state (basis defined in products/term.yaml lifecycle.states)

term_origin.meaning: how the term came about: first term of a new lease, a signed renewal, a signed unit transfer, or automatic month-to-month conversion at the end of a fixed term

term_end_date.meaning: last day of the term (the day before the anniversary of the start date after term_months months); for a month-to-month agreement the last day of the current monthly period

term_months.meaning: length of the term in months (1 for month-to-month)

contracted_rent.meaning: monthly base rent agreed for the term, including any term-length premium or discount

signed_date.meaning: date the resident signed the term (for month_to_month_conversion, the date the conversion was recorded)

notice_to_vacate_date.meaning: date the resident's written notice to vacate was received; empty when no notice is on file

intended_move_out_date.meaning: move-out date stated in the resident's notice, early termination or transfer; empty when none

balance_due.meaning: outstanding balance of term charges (termination, reletting, notice, transfer and holdover charges) net of credits and payments; identically the sum of term_receivable deltas

closed_date.meaning: date the term reached a terminal status (superseded, completed, terminated_early, transferred or cancelled); empty while pending, current or notice_given

offer_id.meaning: primary id of the renewal offer line

term_id.meaning: expiring term the offer is made on (foreign key -> lease_terms)

offered_variant.meaning: term program offered on this line

offered_term_months.meaning: term length offered on this line

offered_rent.meaning: monthly base rent offered for this term length, before any early renewal discount

offer_date.meaning: date the offer was delivered to the resident

offer_expiration_date.meaning: last date the offer may be accepted

rent_change_id.meaning: primary id of the rent change record

term_id.meaning: term under which the new rent applies (foreign key -> lease_terms)

lease_id.meaning: lease whose monthly rent changes (foreign key -> leases)

previous_rent.meaning: monthly base rent in force before the change

new_rent.meaning: monthly base rent in force from the effective date

effective_date.meaning: first date the new rent applies

notice_date.meaning: date written notice of the new rent was delivered to the resident

term_charge_id.meaning: primary id of the term charge, credit or payment line

term_id.meaning: term the line posts to (foreign key -> lease_terms)

amount.meaning: amount of the line, always positive; assessments increase the term balance and credits and payments decrease it

billing_period.meaning: calendar month a lease_break_rent, holdover_rent or reletting_credit line covers; the posting month for other lines

days_charged.meaning: days billed or credited by a day-based line (lease_break_rent, insufficient_notice_charge, holdover_rent, reletting_credit); 0 otherwise

request_id.meaning: early termination or transfer request the line arises from (foreign key -> term_change_requests); empty for lines not tied to a request

source_term_charge_id.meaning: for a credit, the single term charge it reverses or offsets; empty otherwise

payment_method.meaning: instrument of a payment_received line; not_applicable for assessments and credits

payment_reference.meaning: confirmation or instrument number of a payment_received line (the deposit transaction id for deposit_application), exactly as issued; empty otherwise

request_id.meaning: primary id of the early termination, lease break, transfer or rescission request

term_id.meaning: term the request is made against (foreign key -> lease_terms)

requested_date.meaning: termination date or transfer move date the resident asks for

statutory_release_basis.meaning: statutory ground claimed for a release without fees; none for other requests

target_unit_number.meaning: destination apartment home for a transfer, as printed on the availability list; empty otherwise

target_floor_plan.meaning: floor plan of the destination apartment home for a transfer; not_applicable otherwise

target_monthly_rent.meaning: quoted 12-month monthly rent of the destination apartment home for a transfer; 0.00 otherwise

quoted_amount.meaning: total fees quoted to the resident for the request under the term charter (0.00 when none are due)

request_status.meaning: status of the request: signed means the resident signed the agreement

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

utility_account_id.meaning: primary id of the utility services account

lease_id.meaning: lease and apartment home the account serves (foreign key -> leases)

variant_name.meaning: utility program of the account, official utility tier name

status.meaning: utility account lifecycle state (basis defined in products/utility.yaml lifecycle.states)

service_start_date.meaning: first day of billing responsibility (the move-in or transfer move date); the opening date of the account

service_end_date.meaning: last day of billing responsibility (the move-out or transfer date); empty while service continues

billed_occupants.meaning: persons counted for allocation billing, taken from the lease's approved occupants

unit_square_feet.meaning: rentable square footage of the apartment home used for allocation billing

balance_due.meaning: outstanding utility balance net of adjustments and payments; identically the sum of utility_receivable deltas

closed_date.meaning: date the account was closed after its final bill was settled; empty while open

bill_id.meaning: primary id of the utility bill line, adjustment or payment

service_type.meaning: utility service or fee the line bills or credits; not_applicable for payments

billing_period.meaning: service month the line bills, credits or (for a payment) was received in

bill_date.meaning: date the line was issued or posted

amount.meaning: amount of the line, always positive; bills increase the utility balance and adjustments and payments decrease it

usage_quantity.format: decimal with up to 3 places, in usage_unit
usage_quantity.meaning: metered or allocated consumption billed; 0 for flat lines

usage_unit.meaning: unit of usage_quantity: thousand gallons, therms or kilowatt-hours

read_type.meaning: whether a usage line rests on an actual or an estimated meter read

allocation_factor.meaning: share of the property bill allocated to the apartment home for an allocation line; 0 otherwise

property_bill_amount.meaning: community-wide utility provider bill for the service and period behind an allocation line; 0.00 otherwise

proration_days.meaning: days billed for a prorated flat or package line; equals days_in_period for a full month

days_in_period.meaning: actual calendar days of the billing period used for proration; 0 for lines not day-based

source_bill_id.meaning: for an adjustment, the single bill line it credits; empty otherwise

adjustment_reason.meaning: reason of an adjustment line; not_applicable otherwise

payment_method.meaning: instrument of a payment line; not_applicable otherwise

payment_reference.meaning: confirmation or instrument number of a payment line (the deposit transaction id for deposit_application), exactly as issued; empty otherwise

read_id.meaning: primary id of the meter read

read_value.format: decimal with up to 3 places, in the service's usage unit
read_value.meaning: cumulative meter register value at the read (for an estimate, the estimated register value)

usage_quantity.format: decimal with up to 3 places, in the service's usage unit

dispute_id.meaning: primary id of the utility bill dispute

bill_id.meaning: the single bill line disputed (foreign key -> utility_bills)

leak_repair_date.meaning: completion date of the maintenance work order that repaired the leak, for a suspected_leak dispute; empty otherwise

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

deposit_account_id.meaning: primary id of the security deposit account

lease_id.meaning: lease the deposit secures (foreign key -> leases)

variant_name.meaning: deposit program of the account, official deposit tier name

status.meaning: deposit account lifecycle state (basis defined in products/deposit.yaml lifecycle.states)

governing_state.meaning: state whose security deposit statute governs the account (the state of the lease's community)

required_deposit_amount.meaning: cash deposit required under the program before any pet deposit (0.00 on the Zero-Deposit Guarantee Plan)

deposit_held.meaning: cash deposit currently held; identically the sum of deposit_held_balance deltas

balance_owed.meaning: move-out charges not covered by the deposit and still unpaid; identically the sum of final_balance_owed deltas

opened_date.meaning: date the account was opened (the lease approval date)

move_out_date.meaning: date possession of the apartment home ended, copied from the lease at move-out; empty before

forwarding_address.meaning: mailing address the resident gave for the final account statement and refund, exactly as given; empty when none was given

forwarding_address_date.meaning: date the forwarding address was recorded; empty when none was given

disposition_date.meaning: date the (latest) final account statement was issued; empty before

balance_due_date.meaning: date by which a balance owed on the (latest) final account statement must be paid; empty when no balance is owed

closed_date.meaning: date the account was closed; empty while open

transaction_id.meaning: primary id of the deposit transaction or statement line

line_category.meaning: what the line is: a funding type, an itemized move-out charge category, the ledger a deposit application pays, or a settlement line

item_location.meaning: room of an itemized move-out charge (whole_unit for unit-wide items such as cleaning); not_applicable for other lines

transaction_date.meaning: date of the transaction or the date the line was itemized

amount.meaning: amount of the line, always positive; direction given by the event family

item_age_months.meaning: for a depreciable item, full months from its installation date (or last full replacement or repaint) to the move-out date; 0 otherwise

replacement_cost.meaning: full installed cost of replacing a depreciable item before depreciation; 0.00 otherwise

labor_hours.meaning: repair labor billed on a damage_repair line; 0 otherwise

quantity.meaning: units billed on a per-unit line (fobs, trash removals); 1 for other itemized lines, 0 otherwise

inspection_photo_on_file.meaning: whether dated move-out inspection photos of the item are on file for an itemized line; false for other lines

source_transaction_id.meaning: for a reversal or dispute credit, the single itemized line it reverses; empty otherwise

payment_method.meaning: instrument of a funding, payment or refund line; not_applicable otherwise

payment_reference.meaning: confirmation, instrument or check number of a funding, payment, refund or claim line, exactly as issued; empty otherwise

dispute_id.meaning: primary id of the deposit disposition dispute

transaction_id.meaning: the single itemized move-out line disputed (foreign key -> deposit_transactions)

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

parking_license_id.meaning: primary id of the parking license

customer_id.meaning: leaseholder holding the license (foreign key -> customers)

lease_id.meaning: lease the license is an add-on to (foreign key -> leases)

variant_name.meaning: parking product licensed, official parking tier name

status.meaning: parking license lifecycle state (basis defined in products/parking.yaml lifecycle.states)

space_number.meaning: assigned space, carport, garage or permit tag number exactly as printed on the license; empty while waitlisted

vehicle_plate.meaning: license plate of the registered vehicle, exactly as on the state registration (letters upper case, no spaces)

waitlist_date.meaning: date the parking request was received; the opening date of the license record and the waitlist priority date

start_date.meaning: first day the space or permit was licensed; empty while waitlisted

end_date.meaning: last licensed day after a cancellation notice or move-out; empty while licensed without an end

monthly_fee.meaning: monthly license fee in force for this license before any bundle discount (0.00 for an included first permit)

balance_due.meaning: outstanding parking balance net of credits and payments; identically the sum of parking_receivable deltas

closed_date.meaning: date the license was terminated or the request withdrawn; empty while open

parking_charge_id.meaning: primary id of the parking charge, credit or payment line

charge_date.meaning: date the line was posted (the session date for EV lines, the date received for payments)

amount.meaning: amount of the line, always positive; charges increase the parking balance, credits and payments decrease it

energy_kwh.meaning: energy delivered in an EV charging session; 0 otherwise

rate_period.meaning: time-of-use period of an EV energy line; not_applicable otherwise

idle_minutes.meaning: minutes the vehicle stayed plugged in after charging completed, for an idle fee line; 0 otherwise

session_reference.meaning: charging network session id of an EV line, exactly as issued; empty otherwise

proration_days.meaning: days billed on a prorated monthly fee line; equals days_in_period for a full month, 0 for other lines

days_in_period.meaning: actual days of the month for a monthly fee line; 0 for other lines

source_parking_charge_id.meaning: for a credit, the single parking charge it reverses or discounts; empty otherwise

source_activity_id.meaning: for a violation fine, the violation record it bills (foreign key -> parking_activity); empty otherwise

payment_method.meaning: instrument of a payment line; not_applicable otherwise

payment_reference.meaning: confirmation or instrument number of a payment line (the deposit transaction id for deposit_application), exactly as issued; empty otherwise

activity_id.meaning: primary id of the parking activity record

parking_license_id.meaning: parking license the activity concerns (foreign key -> parking_licenses)

activity_date.meaning: date the violation was observed or the guest pass starts

violation_code.meaning: rule broken for a violation; not_applicable for guest passes

violation_level.meaning: enforcement step taken for a violation; not_applicable for guest passes

vehicle_plate_observed.meaning: plate of the vehicle observed or of the guest vehicle, exactly as read

pass_nights.meaning: consecutive nights covered by a guest pass; 0 for violations

storage_rental_id.meaning: primary id of the storage rental

lease_id.meaning: lease the rental is an add-on to (foreign key -> leases)

variant_name.meaning: storage product rented, official storage tier name

status.meaning: storage rental lifecycle state (basis defined in products/storage.yaml lifecycle.states)

unit_label.meaning: storage unit or locker label exactly as posted on its door, such as B2-S014

reserved_date.meaning: date the reservation was made; the opening date of the record

start_date.meaning: first rented day (move-in to the storage unit); empty while reserved

end_date.meaning: last rented day under a notice or move-out; empty while rented without an end

monthly_rent.meaning: monthly storage rent in force for the rental

balance_due.meaning: outstanding storage balance net of credits and payments; identically the sum of storage_receivable deltas

closed_date.meaning: date the rental was vacated or the reservation cancelled; empty while open

storage_charge_id.meaning: primary id of the storage charge, credit or payment line

charge_date.meaning: date the line was posted (the date received for payments)

amount.meaning: amount of the line, always positive; charges increase the storage balance, credits and payments decrease it

proration_days.meaning: days billed on a prorated rent line; equals days_in_period for a full month, 0 for other lines

days_in_period.meaning: actual days of the month for a rent line; 0 for other lines

source_storage_charge_id.meaning: for a credit, the single storage charge it reduces; empty otherwise

payment_method.meaning: instrument of a payment line; not_applicable otherwise

payment_reference.meaning: confirmation or instrument number of a payment line (the deposit transaction id for deposit_application), exactly as issued; empty otherwise

pet_addendum_id.meaning: primary id of the pet addendum or assistance animal registration

customer_id.meaning: leaseholder responsible for the animal (foreign key -> customers)

lease_id.meaning: lease the animal lives under (foreign key -> leases)

variant_name.meaning: addendum type, official pet tier name

status.meaning: pet addendum lifecycle state (basis defined in products/pet.yaml lifecycle.states)

animal_type.meaning: whether the animal is a pet or an assistance animal (service or support animal) approved as a reasonable accommodation

pet_name.meaning: the animal's name exactly as given on the registration

breed.meaning: breed or predominant breed as shown on the veterinary record, exactly as written there

weight_lbs.meaning: adult weight from the veterinary record used for the weight class

vaccination_expiry_date.meaning: expiry date of the current rabies (dogs, cats) or required vaccination on file; empty for species without a requirement

registration_date.meaning: date the registration was submitted; the opening date of the record

approval_date.meaning: date the addendum was approved; empty until approved

end_date.meaning: date the animal left the apartment home permanently (removal or move-out); empty while active

balance_due.meaning: outstanding pet balance net of credits and payments; identically the sum of pet_receivable deltas

closed_date.meaning: date the record reached denied or ended; empty while open

pet_charge_id.meaning: primary id of the pet charge, credit or payment line

charge_date.meaning: date the line was posted (the date received for payments)

amount.meaning: amount of the line, always positive; charges increase the pet balance, credits and payments decrease it

proration_days.meaning: days billed on a prorated pet rent line; equals days_in_period for a full month, 0 for other lines

days_in_period.meaning: actual days of the month for a pet rent line; 0 for other lines

source_pet_charge_id.meaning: for a credit, the single pet charge it reduces; empty otherwise

source_incident_id.meaning: for a fine, the incident it bills (foreign key -> pet_incidents); empty otherwise

payment_method.meaning: instrument of a payment line; not_applicable otherwise

payment_reference.meaning: confirmation or instrument number of a payment line (the deposit transaction id for deposit_application), exactly as issued; empty otherwise

incident_id.meaning: primary id of the pet incident

pet_addendum_id.meaning: pet addendum the incident concerns (foreign key -> pet_addenda)

incident_date.meaning: date the incident was observed or reported
